purpose: Steps 1-3 of the pre-run chain: bind the frozen panel manifest hash, the LD-block version hash, and freeze preprocessing. Nothing downstream (sigma pilot or Gate 0A) may run until status == BOUND. Hashes are computed from the real server artifacts by scripts/bind_data_contract.py; they are NOT filled by hand and NEVER fabricated.

panel_manifest.source: frozen v7 chr22 donor-only panel manifest on the server

block_version.source: frozen LD-block definition over the 154850-site panel

preprocessing_frozen.centering: per-block G - 2p, stats from outer-training fold only
preprocessing_frozen.standardization: MAF-z (G - 2p)/sqrt(2p(1-p)), stats from outer-training fold only
